records.source: Every object is one feature, ROI or annotation, carrying its object type (``cell``, ``nucleus`` ...), its object id and its class; the class defaults to the object type. Each object is traced on its own, so objects that touch stay separate. Outlines follow PIXEL EDGES, not pixel centres: a pixel ``(row, col)`` is the square from ``x = col`` to ``col + 1`` and ``y = row`` to ``row + 1``, the convention QuPath and ImageJ both use. A pixel is inside a polygon when its centre is, so a traced outline rasterised back gives the object exactly: no tolerance, holes and several-part objects included. A hole is an interior ring (GeoJSON), a path of a composite ROI (ImageJ) or, since a COCO polygon cannot have one, an RLE segmentation (COCO).

Smaller boxes claim first, so a hole inside a ring that itself sits inside another ring goes to the inner one.
records.context: ``binary_fill_holes`` over the whole foreground would also fill the gap BETWEEN objects that happen to ring a piece of background, so each label is filled on its own and written back only onto background: a hole never overwrites another object's pixels. Smaller boxes claim first, so a hole inside a ring that itself sits inside another ring goes to the inner one.
records.translation: 对整个前景使用 ``binary_fill_holes`` 还会填满恰好围住一块背景的对象之间的空隙，因此每个标签单独填充，并且只写回背景上：孔洞绝不会覆盖其他对象的像素。每个标签都在自己的边界框（:func:`scipy.ndimage.find_objects`）内填充，这是精确的——框边缘上的背景与框外相接，而该标签在框外没有像素，因此它永远不可能是该标签的孔洞——并能让一个含有数百个对象的 2048 x 2048 视野在不到一秒内完成。较小的框优先认领，因此位于某个环内、而该环本身又位于另一个环内的孔洞归属内侧的环。

records.source: The profiling helpers turn Measure's per-object tables into well and treatment profiles and score them, following pycytominer and copairs so the numbers agree with those tools on the same features. Each object table is aggregated to a per-well median, a plate map adds the treatment annotations, features are normalised plate by plate against the negative-control wells (robust MAD by default), uninformative and redundant features are removed (variance, frequency, correlation, missing values and outliers), and replicate wells are collapsed into consensus profiles. Replicate reproducibility is scored as mean average precision (mAP) with copairs' permutation null and Benjamini-Hochberg correction: phenotypic activity (replicates against controls) and, given a phenotype label, phenotypic consistency (treatments that share the label). Percent replicating is reported beside it. Profiles are written as CSV and Parquet with ``Metadata_`` columns, the consensus also as GCT, with an mAP plot and a consensus-similarity heatmap. Measure runs the whole recipe at the end of a run when ``profiling`` is on.

Measure runs the whole recipe at the end of a run when ``profiling`` is on.
records.translation: 表型谱辅助函数把 Measure 的逐对象表转换为逐孔和逐处理的表型谱并对其评分，遵循 pycytominer 和 copairs，使相同特征上的数值与这些工具一致。每个对象表先汇总为每孔的中位数，板图添加处理注释，特征逐板相对于阴性对照孔进行归一化（默认使用稳健 MAD），去除信息量低和冗余的特征（方差、频率、相关性、缺失值和离群值），重复孔则合并为共识表型谱。重复的可重现性以平均精度均值（mAP）评分，使用 copairs 的置换零分布和 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正：表型活性（重复与对照相比）以及在给定表型标签时的表型一致性（共享该标签的处理）。旁边还报告重复成功率。表型谱写为带 ``Metadata_`` 列的 CSV 和 Parquet，共识表型谱还写为 GCT，并附一张 mAP 图和一张共识相似度热图。启用 ``profiling`` 时，Measure 会在处理结束时执行整个流程。
